ios.desc:
MoodPulse – Mood Tracker and Mood Diary

MoodPulse is a private mood tracker that helps you record emotions in seconds, understand your mood patterns, and improve your mental wellbeing over time. Track daily moods, discover insights, and build self-awareness with a simple and beautiful experience.

Now upgraded with Mood DNA and intelligent insights that help you understand not just how you feel, but why.

Key Features

Quick Mood Tracking
Log your mood instantly with a simple emoji tap

Mood DNA
Discover your emotional profile including mood stability, recovery patterns, weekly trends, emotional archetype, and key mood triggers

Weekly Mood Insights
Get clear summaries of your emotional patterns, changes, and what influences your mood most

Mood Coach
Receive personalized suggestions and simple actions to improve mood and reduce stress

Mood Journal
Write daily thoughts and reflections to improve self awareness and emotional clarity

Mood Trends and Charts
View mood history, streaks, and emotional patterns over time with simple visual charts

Private Mood Tracker
Your data stays on your device. No account required and fully private by design

Premium Features
Unlock advanced Mood DNA, deeper insights, mood coaching, and habit based emotional analysis

Why MoodPulse?

MoodPulse is designed for people who want a simple, private mood tracker that goes beyond logging emotions. It helps you understand your emotional patterns, improve mental wellbeing, and build long term self awareness.

show_hn.title: Show HN: MoodPulse App – a simple app to track your mood in seconds

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built MoodPulse App, a small app that helps you log your mood in seconds and visualize how it changes over time.

The idea came from wanting something simpler than most journaling or mental-health apps. Many of them require long entries or feel heavy to maintain daily. I wanted something that takes just a few seconds but still gives useful insights.

What it does:

• Log your mood with a single tap (with optional notes)
• Visualize emotional trends with simple charts
• Track streaks and weekly patterns
• Share visual mood charts with friends if you want

The focus is on speed and consistency — something you’ll actually keep using.

I’d really appreciate feedback from the HN community, especially on:

• whether mood tracking like this is actually useful
• features that would make it more valuable
• privacy expectations for apps in this space

Website: https://moodpulse.saposs.com/

Thanks!
